disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is purely an artifact of a tool failure (API 400 error) in the first report, not a difference in security assessment. The second report correctly evaluated the package as safe.
coverage_issues: Report 1 (qwen3-235b) failed to review the PKGBUILD due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400), resulting in a missing verdict signal for the primary packaging file.
learnings: The audit tool should implement retry logic for transient LLM API errors (like HTTP 400) to prevent a single file review failure from cascading into an inconclusive package verdict.
